dedupe_keys.name: puntos de conexion refefo access points of argentina s federal fibre optic network arsat open data

description: ARSAT, Argentina's state satellite and telecommunications company, publishes the list of connection points of the Federal Fibre Optic Network (Red Federal de Fibra Óptica, REFEFO), the national backbone it operates to bring wholesale internet capacity to towns across the country. The dataset page read on 2026-09-28 describes a CSV table of the network's access points in service with other data such as the population of each locality, released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence, published on 11 January 2021 and last updated on 28 October 2024, with a stated monthly update frequency. Coverage is national. Access is free download. Caveats: the stated monthly frequency is not met (the last update is almost two years old), the table gives points of presence, not cable routes, and capacities are not included. It supports telecom network models and hazard exposure studies of the Argentine backbone, such as which towns depend on a single REFEFO node. No related Argentine telecom record is catalogued yet; ENACOM connectivity data would complement it.
